_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/test_rename_permanent.py. t_rn_crag renames itself when it resolves -- The Irencrag's clause without the rest of its transformation. t_rn_lord counts creatures named 'Everflame' so the rename can be shown to reach a selector, and t_rn_plain is an ordinary permanent of that printed name so the lord is measured against something.
